deities.name: Bastveig
deities.rationale: Current-reading whiskers, amphibious navigation, floating settlements, and tidal life place them under Bastveig.
deities.public_understanding: Recognized as a divine patron or associated deity within Universalian religious tradition.

deities.name: Thalunesh
deities.rationale: Long-distance navigation and movement among floating communities connect them to passage and wanderers.
deities.public_understanding: Recognized as a divine patron or associated deity within Universalian religious tradition.

deities.name: Ishtanora
deities.rationale: Floating civic gardens and food stewardship give Ishtanora a secondary role in cultivated abundance.
deities.public_understanding: Recognized as a divine patron or associated deity within Universalian religious tradition.

note: These are broad cultural associations rather than compulsory worship; households, regions, and individuals may honor other deities.
